No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this day you compare Mughal garden systems and later cultural adaptations.

Transport from Delhi, the start time, meals and pace are arranged with you, and the quotation states exactly what is included.

What it covers

  • Upper terrace orientation
  • Terraces and water channels
  • Pavilions
  • Garden dialogue

How the time is spent

  1. Upper terrace orientation 25 min

    Describe garden form and patronage chronology.

    You: garden plan

  2. Terraces and water channels 35 min

    Observe axial geometry and flowing water if functioning.

    You: landscape sketch

  3. Pavilions 35 min

    Discuss architecture, leisure and environmental control.

    You: facade details

  4. Garden dialogue 25 min

    Compare Pinjore to Mughal charbagh models.

    You: comparison chart

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Situate Pinjore within its regional historical context.
  • Use observable topography and published evidence to test an interpretation.
  • Produce a concise field record with uncertainty clearly identified.

You take away

A field sheet comparing what you saw.

Agreed with you. Smaller and larger groups are welcome.

Delhi, or wherever you are staying in the region.
What to bring
Comfortable shoes, water, a hat and sun protection. Much of the day is outdoors.
